name: Highborne Tablets
summary: Saria Fairmoon seeks three Highborne tablets from the naga-guarded ruins of Southridge Beach. Their writings record studies of the arcane.

sections.title: Words in Stone
sections.body: The tablets lie in pagoda-like structures among the Southridge Beach ruins, just south of Saria Fairmoon in Azshara. Naga guard them, so she asks you to recover all three and bring them to her. Their Highborne writing concerns investigations into the laws and powers of the arcane. Saria can translate the finer points when you return with the tablets.

faq.answer: Saria Fairmoon in Azshara asks you to bring her three Highborne tablets.
The three tablets are among the ruins of Southridge Beach, just south of Saria Fairmoon.
Their Highborne writing records investigations into the laws and powers of the arcane.
Saria is pursuing knowledge and says she can translate the finer points of the tablets' writing.

faq.q: Why are the naga guarding the tablets?
faq.answer: Naga guard the pagoda-like structures where the tablets are kept.
